driver.root_cause_hypothesis: SFT corpus distribution mismatch (anima axis-conditioned recipes vs academic benchmarks); high-LR LoRA over-fitting; per BG-Xi omnibus 11331fe4 catastrophic-forgetting hint

rows.name: Rehearsal SFT mix
rows.description: 60% anima + 30% academic distillation (MMLU train + TriviaQA train + Wikipedia subset) + 10% chat-template alignment (OpenOrca + ShareGPT)
rows.literature_basis: well-established (Chen et al. 2020 rehearsal; standard SFT mixing)

rows.name: Replay buffer
rows.description: K% pretraining data shards interleaved with new SFT batches
rows.literature_basis: rigorous anti-forgetting; requires pretrain shard access (not in repo)
rows.deferral_reason: cost++ + pretrain shard access not currently available

rows.name: Lower LR / early stop
rows.description: lr 1e-4 -> 5e-5 (2x reduction); max_steps 10000 -> 6000; intermediate eval every 2000 steps
rows.literature_basis: standard PEFT anti-forgetting; may underfit anima task alone

rows.name: LoRA rank reduction (r=64 -> r=16)
rows.description: less expressive adapter; less capacity to overfit anima corpus
rows.deferral_reason: already in flight externally — pods nzw0btc8br78yy + 0jetjpvlm51zoy per omnibus 11331fe4; this BG does NOT propose competing r=16 retrain

rows.name: Knowledge distillation
rows.description: Train against Llama-3.2-3B base soft logits (paradigm D logit-axis); Top-K K=64 KL at T=4
rows.literature_basis: Hinton soft-target distillation; theoretically prevents drift

rows.name: Multi-task heads
rows.description: Separate LoRA adapters for academic vs anima tasks; route at inference
rows.literature_basis: MoE-style routing; adds eval framework complexity
rows.deferral_reason: F1_v3 framework assumes single LoRA; defer to v3 cycle if v2 FAIL
